headline: Brazil opens a public selection for a national AI supercomputer led by LNCC
summary: The Brazilian National Laboratory for Scientific Computing (LNCC), a research unit of MCTI, reports that it is leading technical studies for a new AI-focused high-performance computer planned for Macaíba, Rio Grande do Norte, as part of the Brazilian AI Plan. The FACC official register lists Public Selection No. 27/2026 as an in-person procurement published on 20 August 2026 and closing on 4 November 2026, seeking integrated HPC for AI, research, technological development and innovation. LNCC’s report states a procurement value of R$ 959,040,959.04 and says the system is intended for model development, training and inference and to serve public agencies, researchers, universities and Brazil’s AI innovation ecosystem. The notice, terms and linked attachments did not load in this review. The available sources establish the planned procurement, not an award, delivered configuration, operational compute or measured performance.
